title: Bifunctional glycolipids targeting TLR4·MD-2 and short pentraxins
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2026, 7,820-829
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00324E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Daniele Zucchetta, Lena Nuschy, Simon Gumpelmair, Peter Steinberger, Iain Wilson, Holger Heine, Alla Zamyatina
Synthetic zwitterionic PE-modified glycolipids, prepared via phosphoramidite and H-phosphonate chemistry, bind acute-phase proteins SAP and CRP and attenuate LPS-induced inflammation in a TLR4·MD-2-dependent manner.
